title: Convex schema (guidePages, guideRevisions, redirects), mutations, queries, and seed migration
description: Define all Convex tables and indexes for the CMS feature, implement createGuide/updateGuide/publishGuide/unpublishGuide/changeSlug mutations, all admin and public queries, and a seed migration script that imports existing TypeScript guide content into the DB. Role enforcement at mutation level using requireUserId pattern.

proof.notes: S01: npx tsc --noEmit passed. S02: convex/schema.ts adds guidePages + indexes by_slug/by_status/by_cluster/by_status_and_cluster at lines 1710-1762, guideRevisions by_guideId at 1764-1770, redirects by_from at 1772-1779. S03-S08: npx vitest run convex/guides/__tests__/mutations.contract.test.ts --bail=1 passed (4 tests) covering auth rejection on createGuide, publishGuide non-admin rejection, version increment to 3 after two updates, getPublishedGuide null for draft then published record after publish, and changeSlug creating 301 redirect from /guides/test-slug-a to /guides/test-slug-b. S09: npx tsx scripts/seed-guides.ts --dry-run passed and emitted 52 guide payload summaries with final summary {total:52,created:0,skipped:0,errors:0,dryRun:true}. Note: tsx dry-run needed an unsandboxed rerun because sandbox IPC blocked tsx pipe creation (EPERM).
